title: potentilla arenaria subsp. incana
intro: Potentilla arenaria subsp. incana, commonly known as the Downy Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of the Downy Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and phytochemical research.
